We believe quality journalism should be available to everyone, paid for by those who can afford it.Your support makes all the difference.Read moreVladimir Putin is looking to bring an additional 30,000 North Korean troops in Russia’s war on Ukraine, claimed Volodymyr Zelensky."Since June, preparations have been under way in Russia’s Voronezh region to receive them,” the Ukrainian president said in a nightly address on Saturday without offering evidence.This comes as Kyiv came under attack on Sunday. According to Ukraine’s Air Force, Russia is targeting the city with ballistic missiles.Kazakhstan's president Kassym-Jomart Tokayev said a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine might be reached if ⁠the sides froze the conflict and resumed negotiations.Speaking alongside Russian president Vladimir Putin at a Russia-Kazakhstan forum in the Siberian city of Omsk, Tokayev praised Putin's "utmost diplomatic flexibility”.Earlier, twelve people were killed, including five children, in an overnight drone attack ⁠on a holiday camp in a Russian-held part of Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, Russian-installed local authorities said on Saturday, accusing Ukraine of deliberately attacking civilians. I run for my life’Get off the forecourt now,” shouts Dima, 65, an attendant at a petrol station on the main road into Pavlohrad, in Ukraine’s eastern Dnipropetrovsk region.As the air raid siren wails, he points to an app on his phone tracking Russian drones — now an essential tool for those working on the country’s increasingly dangerous petrol station forecourts. An arrow is moving across the screen.“It’s a Russian Geran-3 drone heading in our direction,” he says. “They missed us yesterday, but they are coming back for another try. You must leave immediately.”Russia has intensified its assault on Ukraine’s retail fuel network over the past month, striking ordinary roadside stations across the east and south of the country.Ukraine’s petrol stations are the latest target for Putin’s dronesWith Ukraine’s petrol stations a key target for Russian drones, customers are advised to spend no more than 10 minutes filling up.
